description: This file defines the ServerRequestCreator class within the Slim Framework, specifically in the Psr17 factory namespace. It implements the logic to create server request objects from global variables or a specified callable.

classes.name: ServerRequestCreator
classes.description: A class responsible for creating PSR-17 server request instances from global variables or a custom callable.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs the ServerRequestCreator with a callable or object and the method name to create server request objects.

methods.name: createServerRequestFromGlobals
methods.description: Creates and returns a ServerRequestInterface object, using a callable specified during construction.
